## What's new

Threadnote 5.0.0-beta.7 makes scoped code evidence follow the project you chose, even across complex monorepos and fresh worktrees.

Threadnote 5 helps agents start from current, cited code context instead of rebuilding an entire repository for every task. This beta makes that workflow more dependable when one project spans several applications and packages.

### Find the right scoped graph from wherever you begin

Configure more than one application or package root for a project, then start from any of those roots or a workspace alias. Threadnote finds the same project-aware graph and follows the dependencies that belong to it, so useful code evidence stays focused even when a monorepo contains many unrelated areas.

Your saved work remains under the project you asked Threadnote to use, while code citations resolve through the graph that owns the relevant source. That keeps project context coherent without losing accurate links to the code behind it.

### Get useful evidence sooner in new worktrees

A fresh compatible worktree can use scoped evidence immediately. Threadnote refreshes the graph for the new checkout in the background, so an agent can begin with the best available cited context while the latest source update is prepared.

The command line now gives direct, honest guidance when an index needs attention, including what to run next. The Manager and CLI also report scoped build progress and queue state more accurately, making it easier to see whether a graph is ready, waiting, or actively updating.
